items.title: A Charge-Enhanced Hydrogen Bonding Strategy for Halogen Bond Activation in Catalysis
items.abstract: Abstract Catalysis underpins modern chemical innovation, yet halogen-bond catalysts remain underdeveloped. Herein, we introduce a charged hydrogen bond-enhanced halogen bond (HBeXB) platform that intensifies σ-hole electrophilicity to unlock reactivity. Mechanistic, spectroscopic, and computational studies reveal a cooperative network of hydrogen bonding, halogen bonding, and nonclassical C–H interactions, delivering exceptional catalytic rates. The modular design of these scaffolds establishes a broadly applicable strategy for next generation organocatalysis.
items.evidenceSource: fresh compact plus attempted primary publisher evidence
items.reason: 合成相关性较高，但已取得证据仍不足以完成可靠的最终纳入/排除。

items.challengeReason: 第一遍从“broadly applicable organocatalysis”判断可能是合成催化方法；第二遍发现现有摘要只证明催化平台和机理，无法回答具体制备转化，因此保留待证。
